x-sap-shortText: Retrieves localized strings for invoice status codes and error messages

info.title: Localized Data
info.description: Enables client applications to display invoice status and error information in the user's preferred language by returning translated strings for internal codes. Supports filtering by code type including approval status, payment status, expense type, payment method, and unit of measure. Suited for Concur Invoice integrations that need locale-aware display of invoice workflow states.

get.summary: Get localized string of various codes in Invoice.
get.description: Returns the  localized string of various codes in Invoice.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Valid types are -    approvalStatus, paymentStatus, expenseType, ledgerCode, dataSourceCode, payMethod, receiptConfirmation, unitOfMeasure.

parameters.name: langCode
parameters.description: Optional. The language code requested. lang codes examples - de, en, es, fr, fr_CA, hu, it, ja, pl, pt_BR

LangCode.description: The language code for the results

LocalizedValue.description: The localized value based on langcode and type.
